tools.name: downloadbridge_transfer
tools.description: Capture + deliver a browser download with a signed receipt. $0.25/transfer; one free transfer per operator, ever. Requires api_token (from POST /register), host_id, filename, source_url, transfer_id; optional x_payment header value for paid calls.

tools.name: downloadbridge_verify
tools.description: Verify a signed receipt (signature + delivered-bytes re-hash). $0.05/verify via x_payment.
